result:
I would make the boundary between self and other transparent.

If the suffering inflicted on another could not be ignored by the actor—if the consequence of harm were felt immediately and viscerally by the one who caused it—conflict would become a form of self-destruction rather than a tool of power. The world would not need peace treaties or laws to stop violence; it would simply cease to find a reason to continue it. Indifference becomes impossible when you truly feel the weight of every life that shares your space.
